name: Global Error Router - Telegram DLQ Template

parameters.content:
# Global Error Router

Import and activate this workflow, then set each production workflow's Error Workflow setting to this workflow.

It writes JSONL records to N8N_ERROR_DLQ_PATH, defaulting to /files/dlq/n8n-errors.jsonl, and sends a Telegram alert with an execution link.

Required env vars:
- TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
- TELEGRAM_ERROR_CHAT_ID or TELEGRAM_APPROVAL_CHAT_ID
- PUBLIC_N8N_BASE_URL or N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL
